name: Pedestrian Dynamics
description: Introduction to pedestrian and crowd behaviour. Scales of measurement of pedestrian movements. Traffic and space characteristics of pedestrians. Understanding empirical measures, data collection: empirical, experimental and field. Small-scale experiments, fundamental diagrams and level of service. Planning and design elements. Planned pedestrian environments. Pedestrian modelling: microscopic - force models, collision avoidance models, cellular automata models; macroscopic: free and congested flow modelling. Multiscale modelling of crowd movements. Time-evolving measures, measure theory-based models. Evacuations - normal and emergency. Software for modelling pedestrian dynamics.
